name: jarrydh-agents
description: Reusable Claude Code agents and skills

plugins.name: four-pass-review
plugins.description: Four-pass code review: completeness, correctness, compliance and consistency reviewer agents run in parallel, then merged into one ranked report

plugins.name: test-gap-writer
plugins.description: Turns code-review findings into tests: one test-writer agent per finding writes the smallest test that proves it, runs it, and reports whether it reproduced the defect. A hook confines the writer to test files
